author: Aliiin2

title: LIFE-CHANGING APP! 🤩🤩🤩
body:
I love writing journal and all small things in my like. Suffered with GERD and anxiety, makes me want to jote down everything I eat and the things that I do that trigger my anxiety and panic attack. 

After jotting down, about a month, I can track again what I ate that led to the attack. So I can avoid the food again in the future. Seriously, all the simplicity in this app makes my life changed 100%. The export feature is really goooood!

Thank you to developer for creating this app! It must really hard for you to gain money. But I will donate sometimes in the future. I promise.

Just one more thing, can you create a feature so that I can add photos in the journal? It will be really helpful to me, because I can create memories.

Thank you to developer! Kudos! And thank you for making the themes free for all premium users! 

😊😊😊

author: azwans.com

title: A great app to track your habits!
body:
Simple design, great features. 

All in all, just the right tool to build(or break) good/bad habits. 

Graphs shows your progress. Quantifies them so it produces meaningful information. 

Great color and contrast makes it easy on the eyes and looks great on iOS!

The new streak feature is awesome! Bring a sense of achieving something!

Why it's not 5 stars?
No Apple Watch app. Hopefully there will be an Apple Watch app to make logging easier. It's a no brainer for an app like this. 

No iCloud support to sync between devices.
